For Immediate Release 


SPRINGFIETD HEAD TO ADDRESS Y CAMPAIGN DINNER 
Dr. Glenn A. Olds, President of Springfield College, Springfield, 
Massachusetts, will be guest speaker at the opening dinner of 
the Y.M.C.A. 's 1965 Campaign this Immsday March 11th at 6.00 p.m. 


at the Downtown Y.M.C.A,. 


Dr. Olds is internationally known as a speaker, writer, professor, 
consultant and educationalist. (See biographical information 


attached) 


The 1965 Y.M.C.A. Campaign is slated for March 29th to April 


12th with a minimum objective of $310,000,
